import unittest

from shelf import store
from tests.helpers import BOOKS, library


class Import(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_new_books_and_known_ones(self):
        lib = library()
        text = f"isbn,title,authors,year\n9780000000001,Salt,A;B,2001\n{BOOKS[0].isbn},Again,,\n"
        self.assertEqual(store.import_books(lib, text), (1, 1))
        self.assertEqual(lib.catalog.get("9780000000001").authors, ["A", "B"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
